title: 🏅 Most cited researcher in the School of Psychology
summary: Over the past year, Dominique Makowski's work has been the most cited in the School of Psychology at the University of Sussex
content: Over the past year, Dominique Makowski has been the most cited researcher in the School of Psychology at the University of Sussex, based on the departmental citation figures ResearchGate reports each month. A nice confirmation of his and his lab's impact and research quality. Congrats 🎉
Update, 2026. The streak has held. The lab's output has remained the most cited in the department in the time since.
